name: What steps are taken during the cabin refinishing process?

mainEntity.name: What steps are taken during the cabin refinishing process?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cabin refinishing typically starts with evaluating the logs for rot or insect damage, followed by stripping or pressure washing to remove dirt, mildew, and degraded finishes. Once the logs dry completely, necessary carpentry repairs, sanding, and chinking inspections take place. Finally, technicians apply base coats, stains, and protective topcoats. As an owner-operated general contractor, HH Remodeling provides a single point of contact on site to oversee the progression, managing the finish work directly while coordinating any related repairs so the wood is properly prepped before final stain application.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes inspecting wood health, stripping old coatings, making structural or chinking repairs, allowing the logs to dry, and applying fresh stain and sealant.
